title: Mystery identity of 'Green Boots' climber is finally solved after DNA test
summary: A 23-year-old Indian climber named Tsewang Paljor has been identified as the famous 'Green Boots' body on Mount Everest after 27 years of uncertainty, with DNA testing finally confirming his identity from the 1996 disaster that claimed eight climbers.
problem_solved: Resolved a 27-year mountaineering mystery about the identity of the iconic frozen 'Green Boots' body serving as a landmark on Everest's north face.
why_valuable: Provides closure to a haunting mystery for the climbing community and honors the memory of the victim by definitively identifying who 'Green Boots' was.
